_comment: Which check catches each failure pattern and which test proves it. Generic patterns (A1..A10, B1..B11) come from harness/core/docs/failure-patterns.md and their titles match it; project patterns (P1, P2...) are defined in harness/project/incidents.md. status: covered - a check with a test that fires on the failure; partial - part of the pattern; none - no check yet. Tests are named module.Class.method and live in harness/core/tests or harness/project/tests. test_incident_registry.py keeps this file honest.

A1.title: The server runs the wrong code

checks.name: preflight: clean tree, main copy, deploy branch
preflight: the new commit descends from the deployed one
deploy stops before anything ships

A1.missing: hash of the running code checked after the swap; code version in reports of long jobs

A2.title: Code runs ahead of the database schema
A2.missing: schema snapshot check before restart; versioned migrations inside the deploy

A3.title: Config drifts between machines

checks.name: supply chain: pinned versions and lock files

A3.missing: required env keys; the same config files on every machine

A4.title: The build is stale or wipes files

checks.name: preflight: build stamp from the deployed commit

A4.missing: build_stamp set in harness.json; a project test that the build never deletes tracked files

A5.title: Permissions, access and secrets

checks.name: guard: secrets are never read
commit scanner: secrets in added lines and in history
deploy check: required security tests
guard: secret files are not written, keys and tokens are not written into files
guard: Grep into secret files and scripts the agent wrote are checked too
sandbox: operating system boundary with a network allowlist, no retry outside it
ConfigChange hook: settings cannot switch the hooks or the sandbox off mid-session

A5.missing: route access matrix test; grant snapshot; env file modes; sign-in with each role after the deploy

A6.title: Broken edits without a linter

checks.name: Stop hook: syntax of changed files

A6.missing: a linter for undefined names (ruff F, tsc) in the Stop checks and preflight; smoke after the deploy

A7.title: Deploys and background jobs collide
A7.missing: preflight check that no long job is running

A8.title: Regressions between waves of fixes

checks.name: regression cases: closed tickets with a confirmed result, replayed by run.sh and in the deploy check

A8.missing: the project's own cases in harness/project/regressions/; the after-swap replay in deploy_health

A9.title: The deploy process stops the deploy

checks.name: guard: a confirmation per deploy command
deploy: notes required, archive from git

A9.missing: files on the server compared with git

A10.title: Documentation diverges from the code

checks.name: QG8: scenarios tied to code, fingerprints, tests

A10.missing: docs.enabled in harness.json and the scenarios map of this project

B1.title: A transformation damages the data

checks.name: data checks: a false-positive counter under a limit (max, ratio_max)

B1.missing: the project's counter on a frozen reference set in harness/config/data-checks.json

B2.title: Sensitive data survives a cleanup step

checks.name: data checks: known values never appear in the output (eq 0)

B2.missing: an independent detector of known values as a project counter

B3.title: Identifiers leak in exports

checks.name: guard: outbound commands ask a human
commit scanner: project ID patterns

B3.missing: id_patterns of this project in harness.json; a scanner of data exports

B4.title: Stale derived data and mixed versions

checks.name: data checks: derived version equals source version (equal), no zero vectors (eq 0)

B4.missing: the project's version counters, run nightly

checks.name: data checks: negative control phrases produce no facts (eq 0)

B6.title: Dictionaries and code groups give wrong sets

checks.name: data checks: control numbers of golden sets (range)

B6.missing: the project's golden sets with control numbers

B7.title: Deterministic rules misread the intent

checks.name: regression cases: answers a human confirmed are replayed on every deploy

B7.missing: plan validation: every condition of the request is in the plan

B8.title: Results are silently truncated

checks.name: data checks: a smoke query returns rows (min), no sharp drop until a human accepts the new level (drop_max)

B8.missing: the project's smoke counters; completeness against a direct query

B9.title: ETL and decoders lose or shift data

checks.name: data checks: rows in equal rows out (equal), no zero-length rows (eq 0)

B9.missing: the project's input and output counters

B10.title: Monitors report success on emptiness

checks.name: gate table: no evidence is unknown, a crash is an error, stale is a warning
a scanner that fails is a failure
no tests ran means blocked
data checks: no output, a non-zero exit, not a number and no checks at all are failures
hooks switched off or not wired fail the gate; golden tasks with nothing measured are not a pass

B10.missing: meters that test themselves on synthetic pairs

B11.title: Service traffic and translations pollute results

checks.name: data checks: the share of service traffic stays under a limit (ratio_max)

B11.missing: placeholder check in translations; deduplication of automated tickets
